data.define: Said to show something is perfect, like a great meal.

misuse.text: Don't say 'chef's kiss' about burnt toast.

data.l1_hook: Coba ini dan beri tahu saya! "chef's kiss"

native.tip: “chef's kiss” = sempurna sekali. Contoh: “The soup was chef's kiss.”
